title.en: How Disney’s Direct-to-Video Sequels Paved the Way for an Entire Culture of Mediocre I.P.

excerpt.en: From the '90s and the 2000s, Disney produced cheap direct-to-video sequels of their most iconic properties. Measured against the sequels of today, these weird cash-ins feel oddly prescient.
